definitions.form_gap: home recent points minus away recent points over the normalized recent-match window; positive favors home
definitions.table_position_gap: away table position minus home table position; positive means home is higher in the table
definitions.points_per_match_home: home team table points / matches played; raw PPM
definitions.points_per_match_away: away team table points / matches played; raw PPM
definitions.goals_for_avg_home_context: home team's home-split goals scored average from team scoring payload
definitions.goals_for_avg_away_context: away team's away-split goals scored average from team scoring payload
definitions.goals_against_avg_home_context: home team's home-split goals conceded average from team scoring payload
definitions.goals_against_avg_away_context: away team's away-split goals conceded average from team scoring payload
definitions.attack_strength_home: mean(home home-split goals_for_avg, away away-split goals_against_avg); raw goals context, not probability
definitions.attack_strength_away: mean(away away-split goals_for_avg, home home-split goals_against_avg); raw goals context, not probability
definitions.defense_weakness_home: home team's home-split goals conceded average; higher means weaker defensive context
definitions.defense_weakness_away: away team's away-split goals conceded average; higher means weaker defensive context
definitions.btts_tendency_index: mean(home home-split BTTS rate, away away-split BTTS rate), normalized 0..1 when available
definitions.over_tendency_index: mean attack environments for both sides: attack_strength_home and attack_strength_away; raw expected-goals context
definitions.h2h_sample_size: number of normalized direct/versus H2H matches
definitions.injuries_count_home: count of normalized missing/doubtful injuries assigned to home team
definitions.injuries_count_away: count of normalized missing/doubtful injuries assigned to away team
definitions.live_pressure_home: home dangerous pressure share from match_situation, normalized 0..1
definitions.live_pressure_away: away dangerous pressure share from match_situation, normalized 0..1
definitions.live_score_state: categorical score state from live_state/final score
